verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents vector search over dense and sparse embeddings using an incrementally updated SPFresh ANN index. It is auto-tuned for 90-100% recall, can be verified with a recall endpoint, and offers exact kNN as an alternative, so the approximate nearest-neighbor core is clearly delivered. Nothing in the pack shows that the distance metric (e.g., cosine vs. euclidean vs. dot product) can be configured, which is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: documented configurable distance metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration of ANN quality.
